sources.title: Gemma (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: In February 2024, Google debuted Gemma, a collection of source-available LLMs that serve as a lightweight version of Gemini. The initial release came in two sizes: neural networks with two and seven billion parameters respectively. Multiple publications viewed this as a response to competitors such as Meta releasing source code for their AI models, and a shift from Google's longstanding practice of keeping its AI source code private.
